improvements: Moved the west arch approximately 70 m east onto the actual span on mapped I-90 way123889285.
Measured approximately 70 m rib-seat extent (±3 m) in independent georeferenced aerial imagery; a shared 68 m span is rendered.
Replaced three crown openings with the observed six; the driving centreline stays open and the bridge deck is not replaced.
remainingGaps: Arch height 13.5 m, rib thickness, hanger spacing, concrete finish and vertical fit to the bridge road deck remain estimates.
Only the arch structure is modelled; this record does not claim reconstruction of floating pontoons, bridge deck or seismic joints.
Aerial acquisition date is unknown and crown parallax is not converted into a height measurement.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.
Integrated source-only replacement and rebuilt district performance are separate acceptance checks; the capture branch predates that shared world policy.
